cases.title: Standing programme paragraph in a quarterly filing
cases.rationale: A company-wide programme with a total charge names no site, no project and no event. It must not become a facility signal.

documents.title: Standing programme paragraph in a quarterly filing
documents.text: Restructuring and productivity programme. The programme includes upgrading our manufacturing facilities and automating our production lines across North America, with expected pre-tax charges of approximately $2.5 billion through 2027. We continue to evaluate our manufacturing footprint on an ongoing basis.

cases.title: The same paragraph in three consecutive quarterly filings
cases.rationale: Recurrence is not news. The same standing paragraph in three quarters must yield no signal and no opportunity, however the dates fall.
